statement: Creating or revoking a break-glass binding has no shadow window; any other change skips its window only with cosec:skip-shadow and a recorded reason.
guards: control:ShadowWindowTest#break-glass has no window, and skipping one needs a reason that is recorded
control:ControlAuthorizationTest#an operator who may publish but not skip cannot skip the window
control:BreakGlassAuthorityTest#skipping a change exempt from the window still needs the right to publish it
